description: Ingest a Segment 'track' event, recording a user action with optional properties.

body.description: The track event payload (may include messageId, userId, anonymousId, event, timestamp, properties/traits).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {success: true}.

description: Ingest a Segment 'identify' event, associating traits with a user.

body.description: The identify event payload (may include messageId, userId, anonymousId, timestamp, traits/properties).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {success: true}.

description: Ingest a Segment 'page' event, recording a page view with optional name and properties.

body.description: The page event payload (may include messageId, userId, anonymousId, name, timestamp, properties).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {success: true}.

description: Ingest a batch of Segment events in one call.

body.description: The batch payload containing a 'batch' list of event objects, each with an optional 'type' (defaults to track).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {success: true, ingested: <count>}.

description: List ingested events, optionally filtered by event type and user id.

event_type.description: Optional event type to filter by (e.g. track, identify, page).

user_id.description: Optional user id to filter events by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {events: [...], count: <n>}.
